project_description: Complete opt-in provider-facing downstream prompt-cache locality hinting without regrowing generic core. Reuse the completed core-ownership/featurehost architecture and marker-aware provider-profile lifecycle; add only a bounded immutable generic backend-feature list if still absent, feature-owned HMAC derivation/fill-only attempt transform/telemetry, generic domain-key derivation with a validated NUL-free label and exact frozen trailing-NUL HMAC input, direct OpenAI Responses prompt_cache_key repair, typed cache-affinity profile projection, and the frozen xAI/Mistral/Fireworks/RunInfra/OpenRouter behavior matrix. Preserve existing source config and compiled capability semantics; augment three current catalog profiles and add the two missing ones. Enforce explicit generation opt-in (absent/disabled feature contributes no canonical-required attempt-transform occupant) to protect the large-payload wire fast path; enabled canonical fallback must not bypass synthesis. Reuse existing executable plugin PCK ABI with negotiated feature at min minor 6 and no new protobuf value fields/minor, updating both current host offer lists. Resolve OpenRouter body session_id precedence against generic extra-body collisions. Keep session authority, continuation, cache residency and keep-warm separate. The frozen generated wire value remains aipca1_ plus full SHA-256 base64url digest (50 characters). All requirements/design/tasks stay ready for implementation after RED revalidation; this PR is spec-only and does not implement the feature.
